set.body: Acceptance criteria: Agreement remains the single comparison seam and distinguishes same identity plus same specification, same identity plus conflicting specification, and distinct identities with equal geometry. Frame specification includes bounds and axis convention; grid specification includes frame identity, dimensions, anchoring, and boundary convention as applicable. Same-id different-spec combinations fail as corrupt metadata with both operands named. Distinct identities require explicit rebind. Bounds.contains(Bounds.clamp(p)) holds for finite p under the chosen half-open or closed-boundary design.
set.title: Detect frame and grid identity-specification conflicts
